senses.d: to agree to take something that is offered to you
senses.e: She decided to accept the job offer after much careful thought.
senses.ep: او پس از کلی فکر کردن تصمیم گرفت پیشنهاد شغلی را بپذیرد.

senses.d: to succeed in finishing something or reaching a goal, especially after a lot of work
senses.e: She worked hard for years to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.
senses.ep: او سال‌ها سخت کار کرد تا به رویای خود برای پزشک شدن جامه عمل بپوشاند.

senses.d: an opinion or suggestion given to someone about what they should do in a particular situation
senses.e: My teacher gave me some very helpful advice about my university applications.
senses.ep: معلمم توصیه‌های بسیار مفیدی درباره تقاضاهای دانشگاهی‌ام به من داد.

senses.d: to have enough money or time to buy or do something
senses.e: We can finally afford to buy a small house in the countryside.
senses.ep: ما بالاخره می‌توانیم از پسِ خرید یک خانه کوچک در حومه شهر بربیاییم.

senses.d: to have the same opinion about something as another person
senses.e: I completely agree with your assessment of the current economic situation.
senses.ep: من کاملاً با ارزیابی شما از وضعیت اقتصادی فعلی موافقت می‌کنم.

senses.d: to tell someone that you are sorry for having done something wrong
senses.e: He had to apologize to his colleagues for being late to the meeting.
senses.ep: او مجبور شد به خاطر دیر رسیدن به جلسه از همکارانش عذرخواهی کند.

senses.d: to be grateful for something that someone has done for you
senses.e: I really appreciate all the help you gave me with my project.
senses.ep: من واقعاً از تمام کمکی که در پروژه به من کردی قدردانی می‌کنم.

senses.d: to speak angrily to someone because you disagree with them about something
senses.e: My parents often argue about money matters, but they always make up quickly.
senses.ep: پدرو مادرم اغلب بر سر مسائل مالی با هم بحث می‌کنند، اما همیشه به سرعت آشتی می‌کنند.

senses.d: to plan, organize, or make preparations for something
senses.e: We need to arrange a meeting to discuss the new marketing strategy.
prep: arrange for sb to do sth
senses.ep: ما باید جلسه‌ای را برای بحث درباره استراتژی جدید بازاریابی ترتیب دهیم.

senses.d: to stay away from someone or something, or prevent something from happening
senses.e: She tried to avoid answering his difficult questions during the interview.
senses.ep: او تلاش کرد در طول مصاحبه از پاسخ دادن به سوالات دشوار او اجتناب کند.

senses.d: a situation in which different things exist in equal amounts or proportions
senses.e: The new policy aims to strike a balance between economic growth and environmental protection.
senses.p: تعادل یا توازن بین دو چیز
senses.ep: سیاست جدید قصد دارد تعادل بین رشد اقتصادی و حفاظت از محیط زیست را برقرار کند.

senses.d: to act in a particular way, especially in a polite or proper manner
senses.e: The children need to learn how to behave properly when we have visitors.
senses.p: رفتار کردن یا ادب را رعایت کردن
senses.ep: بچه ها باید یاد بگیرند که وقتی مهمان داریم چطور به درستی رفتار کنند.

senses.d: the feeling that something is true or real, or that something exists
senses.e: She has a strong belief in the power of positive thinking.
senses.p: باور یا اعتقاد راسخ به چیزی
senses.ep: او باور محکمی به قدرت تفکر مثبت دارد.

senses.d: to be the property of someone
senses.e: This red umbrella belongs to the teacher who teaches English.
senses.p: تعلق داشتن به کسی یا جایی
senses.ep: این چتر قرمز متعلق به معلمی است که انگلیسی درس می دهد.

senses.d: showing no fear in dangerous or difficult situations
senses.e: It was very brave of her to speak out against the unfair rules.
senses.p: شجاع یا دلیر در برابر خطر
senses.ep: بسیار شجاعانه بود که او علیه قوانین ناعادلانه اعتراض کرد.

senses.d: to show that a day or event is important by doing something special or enjoyable
senses.e: We are going to celebrate our wedding anniversary with a quiet dinner.
senses.p: جشن گرفتن یا گرامی داشتن مناسبتی
senses.ep: ما قرار است سالگرد ازدواج‌مان را با یک شام آرام جشن بگیریم.

senses.d: an opportunity to do something or a possibility that something will happen
senses.e: Everyone deserves a second chance to prove themselves in the workplace.
senses.p: شانس یا فرصتی برای انجام کاری
senses.ep: همه مستحق یک فرصت مجدد هستند تا خود را در محیط کار ثابت کنند.

senses.d: to decide which thing or person you want out of two or more possibilities
senses.e: You need to choose between the two job offers by the end of the week.
senses.p: انتخاب کردن از میان چند گزینه
senses.ep: شما باید تا آخر هفته بین دو پیشنهاد شغلی یکی را انتخاب کنید.

senses.d: to examine people or things to see how similar or different they are
senses.e: It is interesting to compare life in the countryside with city life.
senses.p: مقایسه کردن شباهت ها و تفاوت ها
senses.ep: مقایسه کردن زندگی در روستا با زندگی شهری جالب است.

senses.d: to say that you are annoyed, unhappy, or not satisfied about someone or something
senses.e: Customers often complain about the poor service in this restaurant.
senses.p: شکایت یا اعتراض کردن نسبت به چیزی
senses.ep: مشتریان اغلب از خدمات ضعیف در این رستوران شکایت می کنند.

senses.d: feeling sure about your own abilities or that something will happen
senses.e: She felt confident about passing the English exam after studying hard.
senses.ep: او پس از مطالعه سخت، نسبت به قبولی در امتحان انگلیسی مطمئن بود.

senses.d: easy to use or helping to plans and situations without causing trouble
senses.e: Online shopping is very convenient for busy people who have no time.
senses.ep: خرید آنلاین برای افراد شاغلی که وقت ندارند بسیار راحت است.

senses.d: containing too many people or things
senses.e: The underground train was extremely crowded during the morning rush hour.
senses.ep: قطار مترو در طول ساعت شلوغی صبح بسیار پرجمعیت و شلوغ بود.

senses.d: wanting to know or learn about something
senses.e: Young children are naturally curious about the world around them.
senses.ep: کودکان خردسال به طور طبیعی نسبت به دنیای اطراف خود کنجکاو هستند.

senses.d: to choose something after thinking about several possibilities
senses.e: We need to decide what to do for our summer holiday.
senses.ep: ما باید تصمیم بگیریم که برای تعطیلات تابستانی خود چه کاری انجام دهیم.

senses.d: to add something to an object or place to make it look more attractive
senses.e: They decorated the living room with colorful balloons for the birthday party.
senses.ep: آن‌ها اتاق نشیمن را با بادکنک‌های رنگی برای جشن تولد تزیین کردند.

senses.d: to take goods, letters, or packages to a particular place or person
senses.e: The postman delivers letters to our house every morning.
senses.ep: نامه رسان هر روز صبح نامه‌ها را به خانه ما تحویل می‌دهد.

senses.d: to say what someone or something is like by giving details
senses.e: Can you describe the man who stole your bag?
senses.ep: آیا می‌توانید مردی را که کیف شما را دزدید توصیف کنید؟

senses.d: to make a drawing or plan of something before it is built or made
senses.e: An international architect designed the new museum building.
senses.ep: یک معمار بین‌المللی ساختمان جدید موزه را طراحی کرد.

senses.d: to grow or change into a larger, stronger, or more advanced state
senses.e: The small software company developed into a major technology business.
senses.ep: آن شرکت نرم‌افزاری کوچک به یک کسب‌وکار فناوری بزرگ تبدیل شد.

senses.d: to become impossible to see or to stop existing
senses.e: The sun disappeared behind the thick clouds in the afternoon.
senses.ep: خورشید بعدازظهر پشت ابرهای غلیظ ناپدید شد.

senses.d: to fail to do what someone hoped for, or to make someone feel sad by not meeting their expectations
senses.e: I am sorry to disappoint you, but I cannot attend the meeting.
senses.ep: متاسفم که ناامیدتان می‌کنم، اما نمی‌توانم در جلسه شرکت کنم.

senses.d: to talk about something with someone else in order to make a decision or share ideas
senses.e: The committee met to discuss the new budget proposal for next year.
senses.ep: کمیته برای بحث درباره پیشنهاد بودجه جدید برای سال آینده تشکیل جلسه داد.

senses.d: to interrupt what someone is doing, or to make someone feel worried or upset
senses.e: Please do not disturb me while I am working on this report.
senses.ep: لطفاً وقتی روی این گزارش کار می‌کنم مزاحم من نشوید.

senses.d: someone who is paid to work for a person or a company
senses.e: The company offers great benefits to attract and retain skilled employees.
senses.ep: این شرکت مزایای عالی برای جذب و حفظ کارمندان ماهر ارائه می‌دهد.

senses.d: containing nothing; not filled or occupied by anything
senses.e: She left the office and walked down the empty corridor.
senses.ep: او دفتر را ترک کرد و در راهروی خالی قدم زد.

senses.d: to give someone confidence, hope, or support to do something
senses.e: Her teacher encouraged her to apply for the university scholarship.
senses.ep: معلمش او را تشویق کرد برای بورسیه دانشگاه درخواست دهد.

senses.d: the air, water, and land in which people, animals, and plants live
senses.e: We must take urgent action to protect the natural environment from pollution.
senses.ep: ما باید اقداماتی فوری برای محافظت از محیط زیست طبیعی در برابر آلودگی انجام دهیم.

senses.d: the tools, machines, or other items needed for a particular purpose or activity
senses.e: The factory bought new safety equipment to protect its workers.
senses.ep: کارخانه تجهیزات ایمنی جدیدی برای محافظت از کارگران خود خریداری کرد.

senses.d: to get away from a place where you have been kept or where you are in danger
senses.e: The prisoners managed to escape through a tunnel in the yard.
senses.ep: زندانیان توانستند از طریق تونلی در حیاط فرار کنند.

senses.d: to think or believe that something will happen or that someone will arrive
senses.e: We are expecting a lot of visitors at the museum this weekend.
senses.p: انتظار داشتن، چشم به راه بودن
senses.ep: ما انتظار داریم که آخر هفته بازدیدکنندگان زیادی به موزه بیایند.

senses.d: knowledge or skill that you get from doing a particular job or activity
senses.e: She has ten years of experience working as a graphic designer.
senses.ep: او ده سال تجربه کار به عنوان طراح گرافیک دارد.

senses.d: To make plain, manifest, or intelligible; to clear of obscurity; to illustrate the meaning of
senses.e: To explain a chapter of the Bible
senses.ep: توضیح دادن یک فصل از کتاب مقدس

senses.d: well-known to you and easily recognized
senses.e: That voice sounds familiar, but I cannot remember whose it is.
senses.ep: آن صدا آشنا به نظر می‌رسد، اما نمی‌توانم به خاطر بیاورم مال چه کسی است.

senses.d: known about by many people in many places
senses.e: Italy is famous for its delicious food and historical monuments.
senses.ep: ایتالیا به خاطر غذاهای لذیذ و آثار تاریخی‌اش مشهور است.

senses.d: a style of clothing, hair, or behavior that is popular at a particular time
senses.e: Long skirts and boots are coming back into fashion this autumn.
senses.ep: دامن‌های بلند و بوت امسال پاییز دوباره مد می‌شوند.

senses.d: a helpful act that you do for someone
senses.e: Could you do me a huge favor and water my plants while I am away?
senses.ep: می‌توانید لطف بزرگی به من بکنید و در طول غیبت من به گیاهانم آب بدهید؟

senses.d: a series of public performances, shows, or events celebrating a particular thing
senses.e: The town holds an annual film festival that attracts directors from around the world.
senses.ep: این شهر یک جشنواره فیلم سالانه برگزار می‌کند که کارگردانانی را از سراسر جهان جذب می‌کند.

senses.d: To pardon; to waive any negative feeling or desire for punishment, retribution, or compensation
senses.e: Forgive others, not because they deserve forgiveness, but because you deserve peace
senses.ep: دیگران را ببخشید، نه به این خاطر که مستحق بخشش هستند، بلکه به این دلیل که شما مستحق آرامش هستید

senses.d: willing to give money, time, or help freely to others
senses.e: She made a very generous donation to the local children's hospital.
senses.ep: او کمک مالی بسیار سخاوتمندانه‌ای به بیمارستان محلی کودکان کرد.

senses.d: to successfully complete a degree or course at a school or university
senses.e: She graduated from university with a degree in biology last year.
senses.ep: او سال گذشته با مدرک زیست‌شناسی از دانشگاه فارغ‌التحصیل شد.

senses.d: feeling or showing thanks because someone has done something kind for you
senses.e: I am extremely grateful for all your help during this difficult time.
senses.ep: من از تمام کمک‌های شما در این دوران سخت بی‌نهایت سپاسگزارم.

senses.d: to give an answer or opinion about something without knowing all the facts
senses.e: Can you guess how many sweets are in this jar?
senses.ep: آیا می‌توانی حدس بزنی چند تا آبنبات در این شیشه است؟

senses.d: something that you do regularly and almost without thinking about it
senses.e: He has a bad habit of biting his nails when he is nervous.
senses.ep: او عادت بدی دارد که وقتی عصبی است ناخن‌هایش را می‌جود.

senses.d: always telling the truth and never stealing or cheating
senses.e: To be honest, I didn't really enjoy the film at all.
senses.ep: راستش را بخواهید، من اصلاً از آن فیلم لذت نبردم.

senses.d: to form a picture or idea in your mind of something that is not real or has not happened
senses.e: Imagine you are walking on a warm sunny beach with no worries.
senses.ep: تصور کنید در حال قدم زدن روی یک ساحل گرم و آفتابی بدون هیچ نگرانی هستید.

senses.d: to make something better, or to become better
senses.e: Reading every day will help improve your English vocabulary and grammar.
senses.ep: مطالعه هر روز به بهبود دایره واژگان و دستور زبان انگلیسی شما کمک می‌کند.

senses.d: to ask someone formally to come to a social event or your home
senses.e: We decided to invite our new neighbors over for dinner this weekend.
senses.ep: ما تصمیم گرفتیم آخر هفته آینده همسایه‌های جدیدمان را برای شام دعوت کنیم.

senses.d: feeling unhappy because someone has something that you would like to have
senses.e: She felt a bit jealous when her friend bought a brand new car.
senses.ep: وقتی دوستش یک ماشین کاملاً نو خرید، او کمی احساس حسادت کرد.

senses.d: an act of travelling from one place to another, especially when it is far
senses.e: The train journey through the mountains offered some breathtaking views.
senses.ep: سفر با قطار از میان کوه‌ها مناظر نفس‌گیری را ارائه داد.

senses.d: the quality of being generous, helpful, and caring about other people
senses.e: I will never forget the kindness that she showed me during difficult times.
senses.ep: هرگز مهربانی‌ای که او در روزهای سخت به من نشان داد را فراموش نخواهم کرد.

senses.d: unwilling to work or make any effort to do something
senses.e: He is too lazy to clean his room and leaves his clothes everywhere.
senses.ep: او آنقدر تنبل است که اتاقش را تمیز نمی‌کند و لباس‌هایش را همه جا پخش می‌کند.

senses.d: to give something to someone for a short time, expecting them to give it back
senses.e: Can you lend me your pen for a minute?
senses.ep: می‌توانی برای یک دقیقه خودکارت را به من قرض بدهی؟

senses.d: unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone to talk to
senses.e: She felt very lonely after moving to a new city where she knew nobody.
senses.ep: او پس از نقل مکان به شهری جدید که در آن هیچ‌کس را نمی‌شناخت، احساس تنهایی زیادی کرد.

senses.d: to succeed in doing something difficult, especially what you are trying to do
senses.e: Despite the heavy rain, we managed to arrive at the station on time.
senses.ep: با وجود باران شدید، توانستیم به موقع به ایستگاه برسیم.

senses.d: to talk about or refer to something briefly, without giving many details
senses.e: She mentioned the new project during the meeting.
senses.ep: او در جریان جلسه به پروژه‌ی جدید اشاره کرد.

senses.d: an action, decision, or judgment that produces an unwanted or wrong result
senses.e: I made a careless mistake in the math test and lost crucial points.
senses.ep: من در امتحان ریاضی یک اشتباه بی‌دقتی مرتکب شدم و امتیازهای حساسی را از دست دادم.

senses.d: to fail to understand something or someone correctly
senses.e: I think you misunderstood my instructions, because this is not what I wanted.
senses.p: سوء تفاهم داشتن، بد متوجه شدن
senses.ep: فکر می‌کنم دستورالعمل‌های مرا بد متوجه شدید، زیرا این چیزی نیست که من می‌خواستم.

senses.d: a particular time when something happens, or a special event or ceremony
senses.e: Her graduation was a happy occasion for the whole family.
senses.ep: فارغ‌التحصیلی او یک مناسبت شاد برای تمام اعضای خانواده بود.

senses.d: To propose or express one's willingness to do something
senses.e: She offered to help with her homework
senses.ep: او پیشنهاد کرد در انجام تکالیف خانه کمک کند

senses.d: your feelings or thoughts about someone or something, rather than a fact
senses.e: Everyone is entitled to express their personal opinion during the meeting.
senses.ep: همه حق دارند نظر شخصی خود را در طول جلسه بیان کنند.

senses.d: to plan or arrange an event, activity, or system
senses.e: She helped to organize the annual charity conference for local businesses.
senses.ep: او کمک کرد تا کنفرانس خیریه سالانه برای کسب‌وکارهای محلی سازماندهی شود.

senses.d: able to wait for a long time or accept annoying delays without becoming angry
senses.e: Please be patient while the technical team resolves this network issue.
senses.ep: لطفاً صبور باشید تا تیم فنی این مشکل شبکه را برطرف کند.

senses.d: having good manners and behaving in a way that is socially correct and respectful
senses.e: It is polite to thank the host before leaving the party.
senses.ep: مؤدبانه است که قبل از ترک مهمانی از میزبان تشکر کنید.

senses.d: to like someone or something more than another person or thing
senses.e: Most children prefer watching cartoons to reading serious news articles.
senses.ep: بیشتر کودکان تماشای کارتون را به خواندن مقالات جدی خبری ترجیح می‌دهند.

senses.d: to make something or someone ready for use, action, or an event
senses.e: The chef spent hours trying to prepare the special evening meal.
senses.ep: سرآشپز ساعت‌ها وقت صرف کرد تا غذای مخصوص عصر را آماده کند.

senses.d: to behave as if something is true when you know that it is not
senses.e: She decided to pretend that she had not heard the unpleasant comment.
senses.ep: او تصمیم گرفت وانمود کند که آن نظر ناخوشایند را نشنیده است.

senses.d: to stop something from happening or someone from doing something
senses.e: Regular exercise can help prevent many common health problems.
senses.ep: ورزش منظم می‌تواند به جلوگیری از بسیاری از مشکلات رایج سلامتی کمک کند.

senses.d: to tell someone that you will definitely do something or that something will happen
senses.e: He made a serious promise to help his brother find a job.
senses.ep: او قول جدی داد که به برادرش کمک کند کاری پیدا کند.

senses.d: to keep someone or something safe from harm, injury, or damage
senses.e: Wearing strong sunscreen helps to protect your skin from harmful UV rays.
senses.ep: استفاده از کرم ضد آفتاب قوی به محافظت از پوست شما در برابر اشعه‌های مضر ماوراء بنفش کمک می‌کند.

senses.d: to achieve something that you have hoped for or planned
senses.e: She finally realized her dream of opening her own bakery.
senses.ep: او سرانجام رویای خود را برای افتتاح نانوایی خودش محقق کرد.

senses.d: to advise someone that something is good or suitable for a particular purpose
senses.e: The committee strongly recommends adopting the new safety guidelines immediately.
senses.ep: کمیته اکیداً توصیه می‌کند که دستورالعمل‌های ایمنی جدید فوراً پذیرفته شوند.

senses.d: to say or show that you will not do, give, or accept something
senses.e: The company refused our offer to buy the old building.
senses.ep: شرکت پیشنهاد ما برای خرید ساختمان قدیمی را رد کرد.

senses.d: a feeling of sadness about something sad or wrong that you have done, or about a missed opportunity
senses.e: He left school at sixteen with great regret.
senses.ep: او در شانزده سالگی با پشیمانی فراوان مدرسه را ترک کرد.

senses.d: to make someone remember something that they must do or that happened in the past
senses.e: Please remind me to call the dentist tomorrow morning.
senses.ep: لطفاً فردا صبح به من یادآوری کنید که با دندانپزشک تماس بگیرم.

senses.d: to take something away from a place or off a surface
senses.e: He removed his wet jacket as soon as he entered the house.
senses.ep: به محض اینکه وارد خانه شد، کت خیس خود را درآورد.

senses.d: to fix something that is broken, damaged, or torn so that it can be used again
senses.e: My father is trying to repair the broken washing machine in the basement.
senses.ep: پدر من سعی دارد ماشین لباسشویی خراب در زیرزمین را تعمیر کند.

senses.d: to put something new or a different person in the place of something or someone else
senses.e: We need to replace the old wooden windows with modern double-glazed ones.
senses.ep: ما باید پنجره‌های چوبی قدیمی را با پنجره‌های دوجداره مدرن جایگزین کنیم.

senses.d: To act or gesture in response
senses.e: Joanne replied to Pete's insult with a slap to his face
senses.ep: جوآن با سیلی‌ای به صورت پیت، به توهین او پاسخ داد

senses.d: behaving in a way that is not polite and upsets or annoys other people
senses.e: The waiter was very rude to the customers who complained about their food.
senses.ep: گارسون با مشتریانی که از غذای خود شکایت داشتند بسیار بی ادبانه رفتار کرد.

senses.d: pleased because you have achieved something or because something has happened in the way that you wanted
senses.e: I am very satisfied with your progress in class this term.
senses.ep: من از پیشرفت شما در کلاس در این ترم بسیار راضی هستم.

senses.d: bad or dangerous enough to make you worry
senses.e: The company is facing serious financial problems after the recent losses.
senses.ep: این شرکت پس از زیان‌های اخیر با مشکلات مالی جدی روبه‌رو است.

senses.d: to find a way of dealing with a problem or a way to end a disagreement
senses.e: The committee finally solved the dispute after two long meetings.
senses.ep: کمیته سرانجام پس از دو جلسه طولانی اختلاف را حل کرد.

senses.d: to achieve what you want or try to do
senses.e: If you work hard, you will eventually succeed in your career.
senses.ep: اگر سخت تلاش کنید، سرانجام در حرفه خود موفق خواهید شد.

senses.d: to mention an idea, plan, or possibility for other people to consider
senses.e: Can you suggest a good restaurant for dinner tonight?
senses.ep: آیا می‌توانید رستوران خوبی برای شام امشب پیشنهاد کنید؟

senses.d: to help someone by giving them money, emotional comfort, or practical help
senses.e: Her family supported her throughout her studies at university.
senses.ep: خانواده‌اش در طول دوران تحصیل در دانشگاه از او حمایت کردند.

senses.d: a feeling that you have when something unexpected happens
senses.e: To my great surprise, she remembered my name after all these years.
senses.ep: با کمال تعجب، او پس از این همه سال نام مرا به خاطر آورد.

senses.d: to believe that someone is honest, reliable, and will not try to harm you
senses.e: You can trust him with your secrets because he never gossips.
senses.ep: شما می‌توانید در مورد رازهایتان به او اعتماد کنید زیرا او هرگز شایعه‌پراکنی نمی‌کند.

senses.d: helpful for doing or achieving something
senses.e: A good dictionary is a very useful tool when learning a new language.
senses.ep: هنگام یادگیری یک زبان جدید، یک فرهنگ لغت خوب ابزار بسیار مفیدی است.

senses.d: to use more money, time, or resources than you need to, or use them in a way that is not effective
senses.e: We wasted hours of valuable time trying to fix the broken printer.
senses.ep: ما ساعت‌ها از وقت باارزش خود را صرف تلاش برای تعمیر پرینتر خراب‌شده هدر دادیم.
